decision: All changes to dist/ai-controller.js were reverted byte-for-byte. No building/economy strategy enhancement is claimed or shipped from these trials. The separate v75 living-bomb combat AI change is outside this evidence file.

method.kind: equal-budget isolated lane trials, not natural-match win rate
method.engine: Same v74 engine, data and skills for both variants; sandbox automatic AI disabled during isolated combat. The separate ongoing ai-combat.js edit is not called by these building-only trials. Natural runs load both teams combat AI from frozen copies.
method.purchases: All build and upgrade orders use real Game.command, ordinary cost and construction duration. Both variants receive identical scenario budgets; no troop-stat grants.
method.natural: Three ordinary matches through wave3; baseline blue team and player-zero assistance fixed; only red building strategy varies; seeds42,173,615.

rejectedPrototypes.description: Replace invented five-second delay for implemented zero-cooldown knives with a sustained mana-regeneration estimate and real target/damage caps. First three waves retain openingScore.
rejectedPrototypes.reasonRejected: Focused nine trials increased total leaks746→754; wave4 worsened174→209 despite wave8 improving219→187. No stable aggregate improvement.
